rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE COMPETITIVENESS OF THE PHILIPPINE MOTOR VEHICLE MANUFACTURING INDUSTRY
rows.title_short: The Philippine Motor Vehicle Manufacturing Industry Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to develop a comprehensive policy to accelerate the development of the Philippine Motor Vehicle Manufacturing Industry; ensure a balanced transition to open trade by fully developing its competitiveness capacities and promote greater participation in global value chains; promote the maximum scale integration of vehicle manufacturing and the manufacture of its parts and components; and integrate motor vehicle manufacturing into the overall transport sector policy to encourage objective market conditions for locally-produced vehicles in the expansion and upgrading of the country´s vehicle fleet.
Authorizes the President of the Republic of the Philippines to approve a six-year National Motor Vehicle Manufacturing Development Plan prepared by the Board of Investments (BOI) in consultation with concerned stakeholders and endorsed by the Motor Vehicle Manufacturing Development Council which shall define the Industry´s annual and medium-term manufacturing and exports targets, key industry issues, and programs and strategies to support manufacturing and export thrusts.
Creates the Vehicle Manufacturing Development Council that shall act as the central planning, coordinating and monitoring body and national advisory committee for the comprehensive and integrated policy on motor vehicle manufacturing industry development.
Authorizes the Department of Trade and Industry, through the BOI, in coordination with the Fiscal Incentives Review Board (FIRB) and other pertinent government agencies, to recommend an incentive strategy that shall provide time-bound, targeted, performance-based and transparent fiscal support to integrated vehicle manufacturing and automotive supporting industries.
Prioritizes the government procurement, lease or rental of domestically manufactured motor vehicles.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2025-06-04, transmitted to the Senate on 2025-06-09 and received by the Senate on 2025-06-09

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE FAIR USE OF THE INTERNET AND SOCIAL MEDIA FOR THE HOLDING OF FREE, ORDERLY, HONEST, PEACEFUL AND CREDIBLE ELECTIONS
rows.title_short: Internet And Social Media Regulation For Fair Elections Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to regulate the use of internet and the social media as a lawful election propaganda.
Empowers the COMELEC in the monitoring of partisan political activities and sets parameters in holding e-rallies and livestreams.
Mandates contractors and business firms to submit certified true copies of all contracts, reports and receipts, and other documents, accompanied by all its digitization copies, to the COMELEC.
Requires every person or firm to whom any payment for electoral expenditure has been made to file a written report within thirty (30) days after the conduct of the election which shall contain required information, accompanied with the official receipts issued to the person with whom the contractor or business firm had transacted.
Authorizes the COMELEC to promulgate and furnish all political parties and candidates and all concerned entities the rules and regulations for the implementation of this act, consistent with the criteria established in Article IX-C, Section 4 of the Constitution and Section 86 of the Omnibus Election Code.
rows.status: Approved on Second Reading on 2025-06-09

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL PROGRAM FOR THE MALUNGGAY INDUSTRY, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Malunggay Industry Development Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to accelerate the growth and development of the malunggay industry to improve investment climate, boost competencies and efficiency of agribusiness, promote malunggay as a source of livelihood, and maximize its utilization for health and nutrition.
Establishes a Malunggay Industry Development Committee that shall be composed of different government agencies, SUCs, farmers´ group and the private sector.
Authorizes the Committee to formulate a five-year Malunggay Framework for Development which shall serve as a guide for a harmonized and collaborative implementation of policies, programs and projects for the advancement, industry-wide development, and inclusive growth of the Philippine Malunggay Industry.
Mandates the Committee, in consultation with all the industry players, to prepare the Malunggay Industry Roadmap which shall be updated every five (5) years.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2025-06-04, transmitted to the Senate on 2025-06-09 and received by the Senate on 2025-06-09

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING A MECHANISM FOR THE DECLARATION OF A STATE OF IMMINENT DISASTER, PROVIDING THE CRITERIA FOR ITS DECLARATION AND LIFTING, ENABLING ANTICIPATORY MEASURES, AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Declaration Of State Of Imminent Disaster Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish a systematic mechanism for declaring a State of Imminent Disaster that will enable the government to anticipate and respond effectively to impending disasters, thereby minimizing their adverse impacts on vulnerable communities and enhancing the country´s resilience to disasters.
Provides criteria for declaring a State of Imminent Disaster, including objective indicators such as weather forecasts, hydrological data, geological assessments, and other relevant information.
Allocates funds for implementing anticipatory measures, including pre-disaster preparedness activities, evacuation and sheltering facilities, emergency response training, and other necessary interventions.
Outlines prohibited acts and imposes penalties for the violation of this Act.

rows.title_short: Public Service Labor Relations Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to protect the rights of government employees to organize, bargain collectively, and resolve disputes through voluntary means.
Excludes the Members of the Armed Forces and Philippine National Police from the right to self-organization.
Exempts legitimate employee organizations, federations, and confederations from income tax on their properties and donations.
Ensures funds are appropriated for implementing collective bargaining agreements across all government branches and agencies.
It establishes the Public Service Labor Relations Board (PSLRB) to oversee these processes and ensures that employee organization are supported and protected under the law.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING AND ENHANCING THE SKILLS CERTIFICATE EQUIVALENCY PROGRAM OF THE CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION AND THE TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND SKILLS DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
rows.title_short: Skills Certificate Equivalency Program Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to institutionalize and enhance the Skills Certificate Equivalency Program (SCEP). 
Seeks to grant skills eligibility to holders of Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) National Certificates (NCs), allowing them to enter the civil service.
Emphasizes equal opportunities for technical-vocational graduates, the upliftment of middle-skilled workers, and the improvement of the image of technical and vocational education.
Outlines the program´s implementation, coverage, and the roles of the Civil Service Commission (CSC) and TESDA in identifying relevant positions and converting NCs into appropriate skills eligibility.
rows.status: Approved on Second Reading on 2025-06-10
